body:
Patch release v0.42.17.

- Bump `Project.toml` version to 0.42.17
- Update `.buildkite/Manifest-v1.11.toml`:
  - SurfaceFluxes 1.5.1 → 1.6.0
  - ClimaCore 1.0.4 → 1.0.6
  - ClimaAnalysis 0.5.24 → 0.5.25
  - JSON, Krylov, Flux, Zygote, StaticArrays and other minor/patch updates
- Move the `main` NEWS entries under `0.42.17`
- Increment ref counter to 449: SurfaceFluxes 1.6 changes the Monin-Obukhov residual (two-stage surface-callback step, zero free-convection wind speed for `ζ > 0`, profile coefficients evaluated once per residual), and ClimaCore moves 1.0.4 → 1.0.6

NEWS fixes from merges after v0.42.16:
- The entry of #4932 (`ImplicitCloudLiquidFormation`) had landed in the already released `0.42.16` section; it is moved to `0.42.17` and given a feature badge.
- #4901 had shortened the `0.42.16` snow fall speed entry to its first line; the full entry is restored.

No `💥breaking` entries since v0.42.16. #4930 (microphysics parameters folded into the implicit updraft cache kernel) and #4941 (CI staging path) need no entry.
